findings.claim: .okf/components/terraform-roots.md (sources include scripts/tf_validate.sh) says the script validates deployments/applications/modules/bucket, which no longer exists and is not in the script's roots, and it does not mention that a failed fresh init now removes the .terraform/ it left

verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.

The script removes `.terraform/` and exits 1 only when its own init fails, and only inside the branch where `.terraform/` was absent before, so it cannot remove a directory that existed before the run.
The three tests run the real script against a stub `terraform` and assert each row's `fails_when`.
Gates are green.
One non-blocking docs finding: the OKF page describing this script is stale.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pass on gate pre_commit, gate cli_tests, and eval rows r1 to r4.
Stamp green df651e0e3226853502fc9701a57e70d5fb7387c927d371e7379da1fb436d9d82.
`scripts/tf_validate.sh` read in full.
The `rm -rf` sits inside `if [ ! -d "${d}/.terraform" ]`, so a pre-existing directory is never removed.
Under `set -e`, the `if !` form is needed so the cleanup runs at all.
stdout is discarded as before, and init's stderr still reaches the user.
r1: the stub creates `.terraform/providers` and then fails.
The test asserts a non-zero exit, that the first call was init, and that `.terraform/` is gone.
The old script (set -e exits with the directory left behind) fails this test, and a mutant that removes the directory without exiting goes on to exit 0, which the test also catches.
r2: both roots get a `.terraform/terraform.tfstate` and validate fails.
The test asserts the exact call list (one validate, no init) and that the file content is intact, which catches both an init and a removal.
r3: an exact call-list match on init `-backend=false` and then validate for both roots, with exit 0.
Comment against minimal-comments: it records why (a partial `.terraform/` would be trusted by the existence check on every later run), which the code cannot say.
Acceptable.
The file header stays true.
Known and accepted: an init killed by a signal still leaves the directory.
f1 (docs, non-blocking): `.okf/components/terraform-roots.md` lines 204-209 list `deployments/applications/modules/bucket` as a validated root.
That module was removed in 83c34845 and the script never lists it.
The page also says nothing about the new cleanup on a failed fresh init.
The page names the script as a source, so it describes code this ticket changes.
Fix the root list and add one sentence about the cleanup, then run `kmctl check`.
